text: Inca sunt la inceput,am așteptări mari de la aplicația aceasta!
author: gobi1q
developer_reply: Hi! Thanks for downloading our app. Hope Habitify can empower you in your journal of building better routines and lifestyle. If you have any questions, please feel free to let us know via the in-app chat box or at contact@habitify.me!

author: R Larisa
developer_reply:
Hello Larisa!
If you don't have any routine, you can try to do some basic things such as starting a day with a 15-minute training, apply sunscreen every 2 times per day to protect your skin, and so on. Gradually, you can see how you change in the Progress visualization ^^.
If you have a question, feel free to shoot us via in-app chatbox anytime.
